newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner, Gammon in Hong Kong water deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner, Gammon in Hong Kong water deal.

text.p: Anglo-Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner ASA said on Monday it, together with its 50-percent held Gammon Construction Ltd unit, had undertaken a contract with Hong Kong authorities to build a water reservoir.
The contract is worth 270 million crowns, Kvaerner said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
The project is a joint venture between Gammon Construction Ltd and Kvaerner Construction Ltd.
Work is due to begin on the reservoir, which will serve the Kowloon district, in the middle of May and is schedule to be completed in April, 2000.
